implementation.mechanism: Call detector(known_good) then detector(known_broken). Interpret each result as SILENT or FIRES. VALID only for the pair (SILENT, FIRES). silent-in-both, fires-in-both, inverted, and uninterpretable results are REJECTED and assert_both_states raises BothStatesError. Observations are appended to receipt['both_states_observations'].

negative_controls.description: Fixture self-test control: a deliberately broken detector (silent in both states) is planted; the FIXTURE must REJECT it. fired_on_bad_state records the fixture's rejection firing on the broken state; silent_on_good_state records the fixture accepting the discriminating detector.
